title: Panchang and Horoscope — L. D. Swamikannu Pillai

review: Relevant PDF pages 19, 26, 27 rendered and visually checked against text; not a full-book review

claims.supports: Monthly waning Chaturthi / Sankashti; moonrise is the observance time

claims.supports: Maha Shivaratri passage mentions Sravana and second of two successive midnights
